content.short: Luganodes RPC is a multi-chain RPC platform on bare-metal infrastructure, with a unified API key and transparent compute unit pricing.
content.description:
Luganodes RPC gives developers direct access to major blockchain networks through RPC endpoints served from bare-metal infrastructure owned and operated by Luganodes, an institutional staking provider securing $2B+ in assets across 40+ networks.

Each app comes with one API key covering every supported chain and the platform includes usage analytics, alerts and security controls such as key rotation and IP and domain restrictions.

Pricing is usage based with a published cost for every method. The free tier includes a monthly compute allowance with no card required and paid plans scale for production workloads. For teams with custom requirements, dedicated RPC deployments are available on request for any supported blockchain network.
